newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's first half March inflation 0.66 percent.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's first half March inflation 0.66 percent.

text.p: Mexico's consumer price index in the first half of March rose 0.66 percent compared with the second half of February, Banco de Mexico said in a statement on Monday.
In a Reuters survey, analysts on average had predicted a rise of 0.71 percent. Mexico City brokerage AB Asesores Moneda had the closest prediction at 0.65 percent.
It said that the basic basket of consumer goods rose 0.73 percent in the March 1-15 period.
Inflation was chiefly due to increases in the prices of housing, local telephone service, domestic gas, electricity, gasoline, tomatoes and beer, the central bank said.
